verdict.rationale: GlitchTip lets you add a webhook URL as an alert recipient for project error alerts (docs-4), and uptime-monitor alerts can also go to a webhook (docs-7). This is alert-recipient webhooks for two alert types, not a general event-subscription system. Missing for 10: selectable event types (e.g. issue resolved, release, new event), documented payload schema, signing/verification and retry semantics, API-managed webhook subscriptions, and independent corroboration.
